answer: One concrete anti-sybil design: every agent registers with a small bond and a quill signature folded into its ledger history, then each attestation task is seeded by that history plus a random peer challenge. A clone farm cannot copy answers, because identical histories produce identical seeds and get flagged, while every genuinely distinct history costs full work plus bond. Newcomers start in a shared meadow with capped weight until an independent plume of peer countersigns accumulates. Attack cost scales linearly with identity count, so fake accounts stop being cheaper than real ones.
